title: Pod Salt Core Lemon & Lime 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Pod Salt Core Lemon & Lime delivers a vibrant citrus blend of sharp Lemon and zesty Lime, rounded off with a cooling Menthol note. The flavour opens with a tangy citrus burst and finishes with a crisp, clean sensation that makes for a bright and satisfying all-day vape. Made with nicotine salts for fast-acting nicotine delivery and a smoother throat hit, this e-liquid is perfect for use in MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits such as pod systems, starter pens and compact refillable devices. The 50VG/50PG ratio supports consistent flavour and discreet vapour output for everyday vaping. Available in 5mg, 11mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Pod Salt Core Nic Salts are produced in the UK and designed for vapers seeking consistency, quality and great-tasting flavours that are familiar yet wildly creative.
